_doc: Data-driven kits. Adding a 5th kit = a new entry here + a model in art/gltf (model hook = 'model'). Units: metres, seconds, tank percent (0-100), damage vs 100 HP. 'stats' are the 0-10 loadout bars (Range / Damage / Fire rate / Mobility / Coverage). Numbers are phase-4/6 starting values; tuning truth moves here, never into code.
_changes: BOTFIX balance (2026-09-25, game-director call; numbers only): POP-WELL paint.impactRadius 1.1 -> 1.45 and paint.airburstRadius 0.6 -> 0.85 (it readied WELLSPRING ~0.5x per bot per match: 330 weighted m2 painted vs SHEET-DRUM 800); WELLSPRING chargePoints 180 -> 165. Measured with node _harness/probe_bots.ts --lineup mixed --seeds 1..8 on each map: POP-WELL WELLSPRING ready 3.38 / 2.13 / 4.13 per match per kit of 2 bots (Pier 18 / Lockwell / Cinder), used 2.50 / 1.75 / 2.25; before, ~0.5 ready per bot per match on Pier 18.

WASHOUT limits (2026-09-29, CORE lane, CONTRACT_WASHOUT W1; new block 'washout'): teamLimit 51, ffaLimit 20; seaCreditSeconds 5 and spawnProtectSeconds 2.0 are the contract's values. Tuned with node _harness/probe_bots.ts --rule washout --tune (npm run probe:washout:tune): bot-only WASHOUT matches, mixed lineup, skill swell, 3:00, NO limit, seeds 1-8 on pier18 / lockwell / cinder = 24 matches per mode; the leader's score at the horn decides whether a limit would have been reached (the sim never reads the limit before it is hit). TEAMS leader at the horn: min 41, p25 47, median 51, p75 59, max 61, mean 51.8 (histogram 41:2 44:1 45:2 47:3 49:1 50:3 51:1 52:1 54:1 55:1 56:1 59:2 60:3 61:2; per map pier18 49-56, lockwell 55-61, cinder 41-47) -> limit 51 reached in 12 of 24 matches (50.0 %; pier18 4/8, lockwell 8/8, cinder 0/8). FFA leader at the horn: min 14, p25 17, median 20, p75 23, max 31, mean 20.6 (histogram 14:1 15:1 16:2 17:4 18:3 20:2 21:2 22:2 23:1 25:1 26:3 28:1 31:1; per map pier18 22-31, lockwell 15-22, cinder 14-20) -> limit 20 reached in 13 of 24 (54.2 %; pier18 8/8, lockwell 4/8, cinder 1/8). Limits inside the 35-65 % target: TEAMS 50-55, FFA 19-22. The first placeholders 30 / 10 were reached in 24 of 24.

WASHOUT follow-up (2026-09-30, CORE lane, CONTRACT_WASHOUT W1 CHANGED): the limits are now PER MAP in data/maps.json <map>.washout {teamLimit, ffaLimit} (re-tuned on the final core code of the same day: pier18 52 / 23, lockwell 59 / 17, cinder 45 / 17; each reached by the leader in 37.5-62.5 % of that map's no-limit bot matches, seeds 1-8 — the distributions are in the maps.json _changes entry of the same date; the first tuning's 52 / 24, 59 / 19, 46 / 18 had drifted out of the band for lockwell FFA and cinder FFA). teamLimit 51 / ffaLimit 20 here stay as the FALLBACK for a map without its own block (or with a bad value). Why: the single values reached unevenly per map (TEAMS 51: pier18 4/8, lockwell 8/8, cinder 0/8; FFA 20: pier18 8/8, lockwell 4/8, cinder 1/8). Same day, same lane, rule fixes (no numbers changed): spawn protection ends only on an action that happens and when the runner deals damage from any source, a wash clears it, and 'score' follows its 'washed' event at once.

POP-WELL range (2026-10-05, owner request: 'increase the range on pop well a bit, although not as much as needle glint, its almost like a rifle but has very short range'; numbers only): fire.maxRange 9 -> 12 m and fire.projectileSpeed 18 -> 22 m/s. At 9 m POP-WELL was the shortest ranged kit (MIST-RASP 13, NEEDLE-GLINT 12-30, SHEET-DRUM flick 7.5). 12 m is +33 % but stays under MIST-RASP's 13 m and far below NEEDLE-GLINT; the faster shot keeps the flight time to max range at 0.55 s (was 0.50 s) so it still reads as a rifle round instead of a lob. Damage, fire rate, tank cost, splash and paint are unchanged. The touch aim assist and the burst fuse read the kit's reach from this data, so they follow it. BOTS: core/bots/tactics.ts holds POP-WELL bots in a fixed BURST_MIN..BURST_MAX = 5..9 m band (constants, not data), so bots keep fighting at their old distance and do NOT exploit the extra reach; only their projectile (faster, flies on to 12 m on a miss) changes, so determinism hashes change only in matches that contain a POP-WELL runner. stats.range stays 5 (MIST-RASP is 5 at 13 m).

specialCharge._doc: Points toward the equipped special: 1 point per weighted m² of turf newly dyed, +20 per wash. Meter keeps 50% on being washed.

washout._doc: WASHOUT rule (CONTRACT_WASHOUT W1): a credited wash scores 1 for the washer's crew. teamLimit / ffaLimit = the crew score that ends the match at once (TEAMS / FREE-FOR-ALL) on a map WITHOUT its own data/maps.json <map>.washout block — every built map has one, tuned per map on bot-only matches so the leader reaches it in roughly 35-65 % of 3:00 matches (see _changes here and in maps.json). seaCreditSeconds = a sea wash is credited to the last foe who damaged the victim within this window. spawnProtectSeconds = no damage / wash / knockback after a WASHOUT respawn, ended early by an action that happens (a shot / roll / flick / charge, a thrown sub, a started special), by dealing damage from any source, or by a wash.
